וַיִּֽקָּהֲל֞וּ עַל־מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְעַֽל־אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵהֶם֮ רַב־לָכֶם֒ כִּ֤י כׇל־הָֽעֵדָה֙ כֻּלָּ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים וּבְתוֹכָ֖ם יְהֹוָ֑ה וּמַדּ֥וּעַ תִּֽתְנַשְּׂא֖וּ עַל־קְהַ֥ל יְהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
They gathered against Moshe and Aharon, and they said to them: “You have [taken] too much for yourselves [and] since the entire congregation are all holy and Adonoy is in their midst, why do you raise yourselves above the assembly of Adonoy?”


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and they gathered themselves together against Moshe and against Aharon, and said to them, You take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them: why then do you raise yourselves up above the congregation of the Lord?

For the entire congregation are all holy [(all of them heard things from the mouth of the L-rd on Sinai)], and the L-rd is in their midst, and why would you raise yourselves above the congregation of the L-rd? [If you (Moses) took kingship you should not have taken priesthood for your brother.]

and put fire in them, and put incense in them before the Lord tomorrow: and it shall be that the man whom the Lord chooses, he shall be holy: you take too much upon you, you sons of Levi.

And place in them fire, and put incense upon them before the L-rd tomorrow [(the offering of the incense being the choicest of the high-priestly services — but that which killed Nadav and Avihu, who were not elected for it)], and it shall be, the man whom the L-rd shall choose, he is the holy one [(I warn you: Just as we have only one G-d, we have only one high-priest; he shall be proved to be "the holy one"; the others, perforce, having offered "strange fire," shall die.)] A great thing have you taken upon yourselves, O sons of Levi [to contend with the Holy One Blessed be He].

וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה הָשֵׁ֞ב אֶת־מַטֵּ֤ה אַהֲרֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הָעֵד֔וּת לְמִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת לְא֖וֹת לִבְנֵי־מֶ֑רִי וּתְכַ֧ל תְּלוּנֹּתָ֛ם מֵעָלַ֖י וְלֹ֥א יָמֻֽתוּ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Adonoy said to Moshe, “Return the staff of Aharon before the (Ark of) Testimony to be preserved as a symbol to the rebellious people, so that their complaint will end and they not die.”


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the Lord said to Moshe, Put Aharon’s rod back before the Testimony, to be kept for a token against rebels; that there may be an end of their murmurings against me, that they die not.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the L-rd said to Moses: Return Aaron's staff before the Testimony for keeping as a sign against the sons of rebellion [that I have chosen Aaron to be priest, so that they not again contest the priesthood], and their caviling cease from Me and they not die.


###### Numbers 17:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/17:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/17:26)


וַיַּ֖עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֹת֖וֹ כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Moshe did (this), as Adonoy commanded him—so he did.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Moshe did so: as the Lord commanded him, so he did.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Moses did as the L-rd commanded him; thus did he do.


###### Numbers 17:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/17:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/17:27)


וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵ֥ן גָּוַ֛עְנוּ אָבַ֖דְנוּ כֻּלָּ֥נוּ אָבָֽדְנוּ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Bnei Yisroel said [the following] to Moshe: “Behold, we perish, we are lost—we are all lost.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the children of Yisra᾽el spoke to Moshe, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying: Behold, we shall perish; we shall go lost; we shall all go lost!


###### Numbers 17:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/17:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/17:28)


כֹּ֣ל הַקָּרֵ֧ב׀הַקָּרֵ֛ב אֶל־מִשְׁכַּ֥ן יְהֹוָ֖ה יָמ֑וּת הַאִ֥ם תַּ֖מְנוּ לִגְוֺֽעַ׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Anyone approaching, who comes close to the Mishkon of Adonoy will die—have we been consigned to die?”


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Everyone that comes at all near the tabernacle of the Lord dies; shall we totally perish?


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Whoever draws near [(We are permitted to enter the court of the tent of meeting)], who draws near [(more than his neighbor and inadvertently enters the tent of meeting,)] to the mishkan of the L-rd, will die. Have we been abandoned to death?



## Chapter 18

###### Numbers 18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:1)


וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֔ן אַתָּ֗ה וּבָנֶ֤יךָ וּבֵית־אָבִ֙יךָ֙ אִתָּ֔ךְ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־עֲוֺ֣ן הַמִּקְדָּ֑שׁ וְאַתָּה֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִתָּ֔ךְ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־עֲוֺ֥ן כְּהֻנַּתְכֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Adonoy said to Aharon: “You, your sons, and your father’s house with you will bear the sin of the Sanctuary, and you, and your sons with you will bear the sin of your *kehunah*.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the Lord said to Aharon, Thou and thy sons and thy father’s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the L-rd said [to Moses to say] to Aaron [to exhort him to prevent non-priests from entering the sanctuary]: You and your sons and the house of your father [the children of Kehath, the father of Amram] with you shall bear the sin of the sanctuary [i.e., you will be held responsible for non-priests' sinning with the consecrated things that I have placed in your charge — the tent (of meeting), the ark, the table and the holy vessels. You must keep watch and warn them.] And you and your sons [the Cohanim] with you shall bear the sin of your priesthood, [which is not relegated to the Levites; you must keep them from inadvertently encroaching upon your service.]


###### Numbers 18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:2)


וְגַ֣ם אֶת־אַחֶ֩יךָ֩ מַטֵּ֨ה לֵוִ֜י שֵׁ֤בֶט אָבִ֙יךָ֙ הַקְרֵ֣ב אִתָּ֔ךְ וְיִלָּו֥וּ עָלֶ֖יךָ וִישָֽׁרְת֑וּךָ וְאַתָּה֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִתָּ֔ךְ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל הָעֵדֻֽת׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Also, your brothers, the tribe of Levi—the tribe of your father—bring to you, and they shall join you, and serve you, you and your sons with you, before the Tent of Testimony.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou near with thee, that they may be joined to thee, and minister to thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tent of the Testimony.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And also your brothers [the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari], the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, draw near with you, and let them be joined to you [to warn also strangers against coming too close to them], and they shall serve you [by guarding the gates and by serving as (Temple) treasurers and trustees], and you and your sons with you, before the tent of Testimony.


###### Numbers 18:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:3)


וְשָֽׁמְרוּ֙ מִֽשְׁמַרְתְּךָ֔ וּמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת כׇּל־הָאֹ֑הֶל אַךְ֩ אֶל־כְּלֵ֨י הַקֹּ֤דֶשׁ וְאֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לֹ֣א יִקְרָ֔בוּ וְלֹֽא־יָמֻ֥תוּ גַם־הֵ֖ם גַּם־אַתֶּֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
They shall guard their duties to you and all the duties of the Tent, but to the holy furniture or to the Altar they must not approach, that neither they, nor you, shall die.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tent: only they shall not come near the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor you, die.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they shall keep your charge and the charge of all the tent. But to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar they shall not come near, so that they not die, both they and you.


###### Numbers 18:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:4)


וְנִלְו֣וּ עָלֶ֔יךָ וְשָֽׁמְר֗וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֙רֶת֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד לְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאֹ֑הֶל וְזָ֖ר לֹא־יִקְרַ֥ב אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
They shall join you and guard the duties of the Tent of Meeting—all the service of the Tent, but a commoner, [a non-*kohein*] should not approach you.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they shall be joined to thee, and keep the charge of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the tent, and a stranger shall not come near to you.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they will join you and they will keep the charge of the tent of meeting for all the service of the tent, and a stranger shall not draw near to you [(the Cohanim are being exhorted to this end)].


###### Numbers 18:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:5)


וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֵ֖ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה ע֛וֹד קֶ֖צֶף עַל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall discharge the sacred duties and the duties of the Altar, so that there will be no more wrath on Bnei Yisroel.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And you shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Yisra᾽el.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall keep the charge of the sanctuary and the charge of the altar, so that there no more be wrath [(as in 17:11)] against the children of Israel.


###### Numbers 18:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:6)


וַאֲנִ֗י הִנֵּ֤ה לָקַ֙חְתִּי֙ אֶת־אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לָכֶ֞ם מַתָּנָ֤ה נְתֻנִים֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה לַעֲבֹ֕ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Behold, I have brought your brothers the Levites from among Bnei Yisroel, given to you as a gift—for Adonoy—to perform the work of the Tent of Meeting.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Yisra᾽el: to you they are given as a gift for the Lord, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I, behold, I have taken your brothers, the Levites, from the midst of the children of Israel, for you as a gift, given to the L-rd [i.e., they are not given to you for your private ends, but for the guarding of the gates, etc. (see 2)], to perform the service of the tent of meeting.


###### Numbers 18:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:7)


וְאַתָּ֣ה וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִ֠תְּךָ֠ תִּשְׁמְר֨וּ אֶת־כְּהֻנַּתְכֶ֜ם לְכׇל־דְּבַ֧ר הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ וּלְמִבֵּ֥ית לַפָּרֹ֖כֶת וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֑ם עֲבֹדַ֣ת מַתָּנָ֗ה אֶתֵּן֙ אֶת־כְּהֻנַּתְכֶ֔ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You and your sons with you shall guard your *kehunah* [duties] regarding the Altar and all that is within the Curtain—you shall serve—the service, as a gift, I give the *kehunah* to you, and the commoner who approaches shall be killed.”


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest’s office for everything that concerns the altar, and within the veil: and you shall serve: I have given your priest’s office to you as a service of gift: and the stranger that comes near shall be put to death.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you and your sons with you shall guard your priesthood for every thing of the altar and within the parocheth, and you shall serve. I have given your priesthood [to you] as a service of gift, and the stranger that draws near shall be put to death.


###### Numbers 18:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:8)


וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהֹוָה֮ אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹן֒ וַאֲנִי֙ הִנֵּ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּֽי לְךָ֔ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת תְּרוּמֹתָ֑י לְכׇל־קׇדְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִ֠שְׂרָאֵ֠ל לְךָ֨ נְתַתִּ֧ים לְמׇשְׁחָ֛ה וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ לְחׇק־עוֹלָֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Adonoy spoke to Aharon: “Behold I have given you the guarding of my *terumah*-gifts, and all the hallowed things of Bnei Yisroel, to you and your children I give them for consecration, as a portion forever.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the Lord spoke to Aharon, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of my heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Yisra᾽el; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the L-rd spoke to Aaron: And I, behold, I have given to you [with joy the twenty-four priestly gifts, to confirm your title to the priesthood against any claims (such as that of Korach)] the keeping of My terumoth (gifts) [You must "keep" (i.e., preserve) them in cleanliness]. From all the hallowed things of the children of Israel, to you have I given them for greatness, and to your children, as an everlasting statute.


###### Numbers 18:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:9)


זֶֽה־יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ מִקֹּ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים מִן־הָאֵ֑שׁ כׇּל־קׇ֠רְבָּנָ֠ם לְֽכׇל־מִנְחָתָ֞ם וּלְכׇל־חַטָּאתָ֗ם וּלְכׇל־אֲשָׁמָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָשִׁ֣יבוּ לִ֔י קֹ֣דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִׁ֥ים לְךָ֛ ה֖וּא וּלְבָנֶֽיךָ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
This is yours from the most holy from the fire, [of] all their sacrifices—their *minchah*-offerings, their sin-offerings and their guilt-offerings which they return to Me shall be most holy to you and your sons.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every offering of theirs, every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every guilt offering of theirs, which they shall render to me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
This shall be for you from the holy of holies from the fire [i.e., after the burning of the devoted portions]: all of their offerings [(such as communal peace-offerings)], and all of their meal-offerings, and all of their sin-offerings, and all of their guilt-offerings, which they shall return to Me [i.e., the theft of a proselyte (see 5:8)]: it is holy of holies to you and to your sons.


###### Numbers 18:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:10)


בְּקֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים תֹּאכְלֶ֑נּוּ כׇּל־זָכָר֙ יֹאכַ֣ל אֹת֔וֹ קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִֽהְיֶה־לָּֽךְ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall eat it in the supremely holy (place), every male may eat it—it shall be holy to you.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy to thee.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
In the holy of holies [the azarah (the place where "holy of holies" are eaten)] shall you eat it. Every male [i.e., only a male] shall eat it; holy shall it be to you.


###### Numbers 18:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:11)


וְזֶה־לְּךָ֞ תְּרוּמַ֣ת מַתָּנָ֗ם לְכׇל־תְּנוּפֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לְךָ֣ נְתַתִּ֗ים וּלְבָנֶ֧יךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶ֛יךָ אִתְּךָ֖ לְחׇק־עוֹלָ֑ם כׇּל־טָה֥וֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ יֹאכַ֥ל אֹתֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Their *terumah*-gift is yours, of all of the wave-offerings of Bnei Yisroel I give to you and to your sons and daughters that are with you as an everlasting portion; all those ritually pure in your house may eat it.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, for all the wave offerings of the children of Yisra᾽el: I have given them to thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And this is for you: the terumah of their gift [-offerings, i.e., what is set apart from the thanksgiving offering, the peace-offerings, and the ram of the Nazirite.] From all the wave-offerings of the children of Israel, to you have I given them, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as an everlasting statute. Every clean one in your house shall eat it.


###### Numbers 18:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:12)


כֹּ֚ל חֵ֣לֶב יִצְהָ֔ר וְכׇל־חֵ֖לֶב תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְדָגָ֑ן רֵאשִׁיתָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־יִתְּנ֥וּ לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה לְךָ֥ נְתַתִּֽים׃

The best of the oil, and the best of the wine and grain—their *terumah*-gift that they present to Adonoy—I have given to you.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the first of them which they shall offer to the Lord, them have I given thee.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat; the first of them [terumah gedolah] which they shall give to the L-rd, to you have I given them.


###### Numbers 18:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:13)


בִּכּוּרֵ֞י כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּאַרְצָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־יָבִ֥יאוּ לַיהֹוָ֖ה לְךָ֣ יִהְיֶ֑ה כׇּל־טָה֥וֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ יֹאכְלֶֽנּוּ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The first fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring before Adonoy, shall be yours; all those ritually pure in your house may eat it.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The first ripe fruit of all that is in the land, which they shall bring to the Lord, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The first-fruits of all that is in their land, that they bring to the L-rd, for you shall it be. Every clean one of your household shall eat it.


###### Numbers 18:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/18:14)

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Everything consecrated in Israel shall be yours.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Everything devoted in Yisra᾽el shall be thine.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Every devoted thing in Israel shall be yours.

וְלֹֽא־תִשְׂא֤וּ עָלָיו֙ חֵ֔טְא בַּהֲרִֽימְכֶ֥ם אֶת־חֶלְבּ֖וֹ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְאֶת־קׇדְשֵׁ֧י בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לֹ֥א תְחַלְּל֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תָמֽוּתוּ׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You will not bear a sin because of it, when you separate its best part; but sacred things of Bnei Yisroel you must not profane, and you will not die.”’


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And you shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have set aside from it the best of it: nor shall you pollute the holy things of the children of Yisra᾽el, lest you die.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall not bear sin because of it when you separate the best part of it, [(but if you do not separate it, you will bear sin.)] And you shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, and you shall not die, [(but if you do profane them, you shall die.)]



## Chapter 19

###### Numbers 19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:1)


וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Adonoy spoke to Moshe and Aharon, saying.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the Lord spoke to Moshe and to Aharon, saying,


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the L-rd spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying:


###### Numbers 19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:2)


זֹ֚את חֻקַּ֣ת הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר דַּבֵּ֣ר**׀** אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֣וּ אֵלֶ֩יךָ֩ פָרָ֨ה אֲדֻמָּ֜ה תְּמִימָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵֽין־בָּהּ֙ מ֔וּם אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־עָלָ֥ה עָלֶ֖יהָ עֹֽל׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
This is the statute of the Torah which Adonoy commanded, saying; speak to Bnei Yisroel that they shall take to you a red, perfect cow without a blemish, upon which no yoke was laid.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
This is the ordinance of the Tora which the Lord has commanded, saying, Speak to the children of Yisra᾽el, that they bring thee a red heifer without defect, in which there is no blemish, and upon which never came a yoke:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(In anticipation of the taunts of the gentiles as to the seemingly arbitrary nature of this mitzvah:) This is the statute [i.e., decree] of the Torah [(You are not given license to seek its rationale)], which the L-rd has commanded, saying: Speak to the children of Israel and they shall take unto you [(It shall always be called by your name, viz., "the red heifer that Moses 'processed' in the desert")], a red heifer, whole [in its redness (two black hairs invalidate it)], which does not have a blemish, upon which a yoke has not come.


###### Numbers 19:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:3)


וּנְתַתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔הּ אֶל־אֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְהוֹצִ֤יא אֹתָהּ֙ אֶל־מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְשָׁחַ֥ט אֹתָ֖הּ לְפָנָֽיו׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Give it to Elozor the *kohein*; he shall take it outside the camp, and someone shall slaughter it in his presence.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and you shall give her to El῾azar the priest, that he may bring her outside the camp, and she shall be slaughtered before his face:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall give it to Elazar the Cohein [(Its mitzvah is by agency of the adjutant high-priest)]. And he shall take it outside the encampment [i.e., outside the three camps] and he [a non-priest] shall slaughter it before him [i.e., Elazar looking on].


###### Numbers 19:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:4)


וְלָקַ֞ח אֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מִדָּמָ֖הּ בְּאֶצְבָּע֑וֹ וְהִזָּ֞ה אֶל־נֹ֨כַח פְּנֵ֧י אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֛ד מִדָּמָ֖הּ שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִֽים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Elozor the *kohein* shall take some of its blood with his finger and sprinkle it directly facing the Tent of Meeting, some of its blood seven times.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and El῾azar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood towards the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Elazar the Cohein shall take of its blood with his finger, and he shall sprinkle of its blood opposite the face of the tent of meeting seven times. [He stands in the east of Jerusalem and directs his gaze to the door of the sanctuary while sprinkling.]


###### Numbers 19:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:5)


וְשָׂרַ֥ף אֶת־הַפָּרָ֖ה לְעֵינָ֑יו אֶת־עֹרָ֤הּ וְאֶת־בְּשָׂרָהּ֙ וְאֶת־דָּמָ֔הּ עַל־פִּרְשָׁ֖הּ יִשְׂרֹֽף׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Someone shall burn the cow in his presence; its skin, flesh, blood, with its waste (that are in its intestines) shall be burned.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and the heifer shall be burnt in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall be burnt:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he shall burn the heifer before his eyes. Its skin, and its flesh, and its blood, together with its dung, he shall burn.


###### Numbers 19:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:6)


וְלָקַ֣ח הַכֹּהֵ֗ן עֵ֥ץ אֶ֛רֶז וְאֵז֖וֹב וּשְׁנִ֣י תוֹלָ֑עַת וְהִשְׁלִ֕יךְ אֶל־תּ֖וֹךְ שְׂרֵפַ֥ת הַפָּרָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The *kohein* shall take a piece of cedar wood, hyssop, and crimson wool, and throw them into the burning of the cow.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein shall take cedar wood, and hyssop and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.


###### Numbers 19:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:7)


וְכִבֶּ֨ס בְּגָדָ֜יו הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְרָחַ֤ץ בְּשָׂרוֹ֙ בַּמַּ֔יִם וְאַחַ֖ר יָבֹ֣א אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְטָמֵ֥א הַכֹּהֵ֖ן עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Then the *kohein* shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water, and afterwards he may enter the camp; [however,] the *kohein* shall be impure until the evening.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterwards he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Cohein shall wash his garments, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and then he may come into the encampment [of the Shechinah (whence he had been excluded)], and the Cohein shall be unclean until the evening [i.e., he shall be unclean until the evening and then he may come into the encampment.]


###### Numbers 19:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:8)


וְהַשֹּׂרֵ֣ף אֹתָ֔הּ יְכַבֵּ֤ס בְּגָדָיו֙ בַּמַּ֔יִם וְרָחַ֥ץ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְטָמֵ֖א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Also, the one who burns it must wash his garments and bathe his body in water; he shall remain unclean until the evening.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he that burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he who burns it shall wash his garments with water and bathe his flesh in water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.


###### Numbers 19:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:9)


וְאָסַ֣ף**׀** אִ֣ישׁ טָה֗וֹר אֵ֚ת אֵ֣פֶר הַפָּרָ֔ה וְהִנִּ֛יחַ מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה בְּמָק֣וֹם טָה֑וֹר וְ֠הָיְתָ֠ה לַעֲדַ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לְמִשְׁמֶ֛רֶת לְמֵ֥י נִדָּ֖ה חַטָּ֥את הִֽוא׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
A ritually clean person shall gather the cow’s ashes and place [it] outside the camp in a clean place; it shall remain a keepsake for the community of Bnei Yisroel for sprinkling water for purification.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them outside the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Yisra᾽el for the water of sprinkling: it is a purification offering.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And a man who is clean shall gather the ashes of the heifer and place it outside the encampment in a clean place. And it shall be for the congregation of the children of Israel in keeping for waters of sprinkling; it is for cleansing.


###### Numbers 19:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:10)


וְ֠כִבֶּ֠ס הָאֹסֵ֨ף אֶת־אֵ֤פֶר הַפָּרָה֙ אֶת־בְּגָדָ֔יו וְטָמֵ֖א עַד־הָעָ֑רֶב וְֽהָיְתָ֞ה לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְלַגֵּ֛ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתוֹכָ֖ם לְחֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The one who gathers the cow’s ashes shall wash his garments, and remain unclean until the evening; it shall be for Bnei Yisroel and for the proselyte who lives among them an eternal statute.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he that gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening: and it shall be to the children of Yisra᾽el, and to the stranger that sojourns among them, for a statute for ever.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his garments, and he shall be unclean until the evening. And it shall be for the children of Israel and for the sojourner who dwells in their midst as an everlasting statute.


###### Numbers 19:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:11)


הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּמֵ֖ת לְכׇל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם וְטָמֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
One who touches the corpse of any [human] soul shall become unclean for seven days.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He that touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
One who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.


###### Numbers 19:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:12)


ה֣וּא יִתְחַטָּא־ב֞וֹ בַּיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֛י וּבַיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י יִטְהָ֑ר וְאִם־לֹ֨א יִתְחַטָּ֜א בַּיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֛י וּבַיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י לֹ֥א יִטְהָֽר׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall cleanse himself with it on the third day and on the seventh day, so that he may become clean; if he does not have himself cleansed on the third day and on the seventh day, he will not become clean.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If he purify himself with it on the third day and on the seventh day, he shall be clean: but if he do not purify himself on the third day and the seventh day, he shall not be clean.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He shall be cleansed with it [the ashes] on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean. And if he is not cleansed on the third day, then he shall not be clean on the seventh day.


###### Numbers 19:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:13)


כׇּֽל־הַנֹּגֵ֡עַ בְּמֵ֣ת בְּנֶ֩פֶשׁ֩ הָאָדָ֨ם אֲשֶׁר־יָמ֜וּת וְלֹ֣א יִתְחַטָּ֗א אֶת־מִשְׁכַּ֤ן יְהֹוָה֙ טִמֵּ֔א וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּי֩ מֵ֨י נִדָּ֜ה לֹא־זֹרַ֤ק עָלָיו֙ טָמֵ֣א יִהְיֶ֔ה ע֖וֹד טֻמְאָת֥וֹ בֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Whoever touches a corpse of a [human] soul, who died and does not have himself cleansed defiles the *Mishkan* of Adonoy (if he enters it), that soul will be cut off from Yisroel; because the sprinkling water was not sprinkled on him, he will be impure his impurity remains.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Whoever touches the dead body of any man that has died, and purifies not himself, he defiles the tabernacle of the Lord; and that soul shall be cut off from Yisra᾽el: because the water of sprinkling was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Everyone who touches a dead body of the soul of a man that shall die [(This excludes "the soul of a beast," one who touches its carcass not requiring sprinkling)], and he not be cleansed, the tabernacle of the L-rd has he defiled [if he enters the tabernacle without the sprinkling of the third and seventh days], and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; for the waters of sprinkling have not been sprinkled upon him. Unclean shall he be; his cleanliness is yet upon him [even if he underwent ritual immersion].


###### Numbers 19:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:14)


זֹ֚את הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אָדָ֖ם כִּֽי־יָמ֣וּת בְּאֹ֑הֶל כׇּל־הַבָּ֤א אֶל־הָאֹ֙הֶל֙ וְכׇל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּאֹ֔הֶל יִטְמָ֖א שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
This is the law [regarding] a person who dies in a tent; anyone who enters the tent and everything that is in the tent shall be unclean for seven days.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
This is the Tora: when a man dies in a tent, all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
This is the Torah: A man if he die in a tent — all that enter the tent [while the dead body is still in it] and all that is in the tent shall be unclean seven days.


###### Numbers 19:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:15)


וְכֹל֙ כְּלִ֣י פָת֔וּחַ אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֵין־צָמִ֥יד פָּתִ֖יל עָלָ֑יו טָמֵ֖א הֽוּא׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Any open utensil that has no cover fastened to it, shall be unclean.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And every open vessel, which has no covering bound upon it, is unclean.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And every open [earthen] vessel whose cover is not fastened upon it is unclean.


###### Numbers 19:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:16)


וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּ֜ע עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה בַּֽחֲלַל־חֶ֙רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בְמֵ֔ת אֽוֹ־בְעֶ֥צֶם אָדָ֖ם א֣וֹ בְקָ֑בֶר יִטְמָ֖א שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Anyone who touches, in an open field, one slain by the sword, a corpse, human bone, or grave, shall be unclean for seven days.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And whoever touches one that is slain with a sword in the open field, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And all who touch, on the face of the field, [where there is no tent (in which instance uncleanliness is conferred only through touching)] one slain by the sword, or a dead body, or the bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.


###### Numbers 19:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:17)


וְלָֽקְחוּ֙ לַטָּמֵ֔א מֵעֲפַ֖ר שְׂרֵפַ֣ת הַֽחַטָּ֑את וְנָתַ֥ן עָלָ֛יו מַ֥יִם חַיִּ֖ים אֶל־כֶּֽלִי׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
They shall take for the unclean person of the ashes from the burnt purification-offering and he shall place upon them living [spring] water in a vessel.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt purification offering, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they shall take for the unclean one from the ashes of the burning of the (heifer for) cleansing, and he shall place upon it (the ashes) living water which is in a vessel.


###### Numbers 19:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:18)


וְלָקַ֨ח אֵז֜וֹב וְטָבַ֣ל בַּמַּ֘יִם֮ אִ֣ישׁ טָהוֹר֒ וְהִזָּ֤ה עַל־הָאֹ֙הֶל֙ וְעַל־כׇּל־הַכֵּלִ֔ים וְעַל־הַנְּפָשׁ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָֽיוּ־שָׁ֑ם וְעַל־הַנֹּגֵ֗עַ בַּעֶ֙צֶם֙ א֣וֹ בֶֽחָלָ֔ל א֥וֹ בַמֵּ֖ת א֥וֹ בַקָּֽבֶר׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
He shall take hyssop and dip it into the water; [this is done by] a ritually clean person, he shall sprinkle it on the tent, on all the utensils and people that were there, and on anyone who touched the bone, murder victim, corpse, or grave.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And a clean man shall take hyssop and dip it in the water, and he shall sprinkle it upon the tent and upon all the vessels, and upon the souls who were there, and upon him who touched a bone, or a slain one, or a dead body, or a grave.


###### Numbers 19:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/19:19)


וְהִזָּ֤ה הַטָּהֹר֙ עַל־הַטָּמֵ֔א בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֖י וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֑י וְחִטְּאוֹ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָהֵ֥ר בָּעָֽרֶב׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The ritually clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day; he shall purify him on the seventh day when he must wash his garments and bathe in water, and then he becomes clean in the evening.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the clean one shall sprinkle on the unclean one on the third day and on the seventh day, and he shall cleanse him on the seventh day [i.e., that is the consummation of his cleansing]; and he shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be clean in the evening.

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
A person who became ritually unclean [and enters the Sanctuary] without purifying himself, that soul will be cut off from the community; for he defiled the Sanctuary of Adonoy, the sprinkling water was not sprinkled upon him, he remains unclean.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the Lord: the water of sprinkling has not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And a man, if he becomes unclean and does not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from the midst of the congregation, for he has defiled the sanctuary of the L-rd. The waters of sprinkling have not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.


###### Numbers 19:21

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
This shall be the statute for all times; one who sprinkles the sprinkling waters shall wash his garments, and one who touches the sprinkling waters shall remain unclean until the evening.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And it shall be for them for an everlasting statute. And the sprinkler of the waters of sprinkling [i.e., he who bears an amount sufficient for sprinkling (but not the sprinkler himself)] shall wash his clothing [as opposed to the toucher (whose garments are not rendered unclean)], and he who touches the waters of sprinkling shall be unclean until the evening.

Anything which the unclean person touches, shall become unclean; and anyone touching him shall be ritually unclean until the evening.

And all that the unclean one [who touched a dead body] touches shall become unclean; and the soul that touches ["the unclean one" (above)] shall be unclean until the evening.

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The entire community of Bnei Yisroel came to the wilderness of Tzin, in the first month. The people settled in Kodeish, and Miriam died and was buried there.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then came the children of Yisra᾽el, the whole congregation, into the desert of Żin in the first month: and the people abode in Qadesh, and Miryam died there, and was buried there.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the children of Israel came, the entire congregation [i.e., the "intact" congregation (those who were condemned to die in the desert having already expired)], to the desert of Tzin on the first month. And the people dwelt in Kadesh, and Miriam died there [(her death being juxtaposed with the section of the red heifer to teach that just as sacrifices atone, so does the death of the righteous)] [("And Miriam died there") by the mouth of the L-rd" (the "Divine kiss") as Aaron (33:38) (Scripture avoids explicit mention of this in the instance of a woman)], and she was buried there.

There was no water for the community, and they assembled against Moshe and Aharon.

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Numbers 20:15

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**

###### Numbers 21:1

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**

and the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, I would now have slain thee, and saved her alive.

###### Numbers 22:34

## Chapter 23

###### Numbers 23:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/23:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/23:1)


וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בִּלְעָם֙ אֶל־בָּלָ֔ק בְּנֵה־לִ֥י בָזֶ֖ה שִׁבְעָ֣ה מִזְבְּחֹ֑ת וְהָכֵ֥ן לִי֙ בָּזֶ֔ה שִׁבְעָ֥ה פָרִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה אֵילִֽים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Bil’am said to Balak: “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare for me seven bulls and seven rams.”


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Bil῾am said to Balaq, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Bilam said to Balak: Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.


###### Numbers 23:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/23:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/23:2)


וַיַּ֣עַשׂ בָּלָ֔ק כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֣ר בִּלְעָ֑ם וַיַּ֨עַל בָּלָ֧ק וּבִלְעָ֛ם פָּ֥ר וָאַ֖יִל בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Balak did as Bilam had spoken, and Balak and Bilam offered a bullock and a ram on (each) altar.


###### Numbers 23:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/23:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/23:3)


וַיֹּ֨אמֶר בִּלְעָ֜ם לְבָלָ֗ק הִתְיַצֵּב֮ עַל־עֹלָתֶ֒ךָ֒ וְאֵֽלְכָ֗ה אוּלַ֞י יִקָּרֵ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ לִקְרָאתִ֔י וּדְבַ֥ר מַה־יַּרְאֵ֖נִי וְהִגַּ֣דְתִּי לָ֑ךְ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ שֶֽׁפִי׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Bil’am said to Balak: “Stand beside your burnt-offering and I will go away. Perhaps, Adonoy will appear to me, and whatever He will show me I will tell you.” And he went away alone.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Bil῾am said to Balaq, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: perhaps the Lord will come to meet me; and whatever he shows me I will tell thee. And he went to a steep place.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Bilam said to Balak: Stand by your burnt-offering and I will go; perhaps the (word of) the L-rd will chance to (come to) me [(He is not wont to speak with me in the daytime)], and I will tell you; and he went off alone.


###### Numbers 23:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/23:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/23:4)

###### Numbers 28:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:12)


וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לַפָּ֖ר הָאֶחָ֑ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לָאַ֖יִל הָֽאֶחָֽד׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
And three tenths [of an *eiphah*] of fine flour as a meal-offering mixed with the [olive] oil for each bull, two tenths [of an *eiphah*] of fine flour as a meal-offering, mixed with the [olive] oil for the one ram,


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and three tenth measures of flour for a meal offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth measures of flour for a meal offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And three esronim of flour for a meal-offering, [as with the fixed libations for a bullock (15:9)], mixed with oil for the one bullock, and two esronim of flour for a meal-offering, mixed with oil for the one ram.


###### Numbers 28:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:13)


וְעִשָּׂרֹ֣ן עִשָּׂר֗וֹן סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד עֹלָה֙ רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
And one tenth [of an *eiphah*] of fine flour as a meal-offering mixed with the [olive] oil for each lamb. A burnt-offering of pleasing aroma, a fire-offering to Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and a tenth measure of flour mingled with oil for a meal offering for every lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire to the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And issaron, issaron of flour for a meal-offering, mixed with oil, for the one lamb, for a burnt-offering, a sweet savor, a fire-offering to the L-rd.


###### Numbers 28:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:14)


וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֗ם חֲצִ֣י הַהִין֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לַפָּ֜ר וּשְׁלִישִׁ֧ת הַהִ֣ין לָאַ֗יִל וּרְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִ֛ין לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ יָ֑יִן זֹ֣את עֹלַ֥ת חֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ בְּחׇדְשׁ֔וֹ לְחׇדְשֵׁ֖י הַשָּׁנָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Their libations [shall be], one half of a *hin* for (a) bull, one third of a *hin* for the ram, and one fourth of a *hin* for (the) lamb, of wine. This is the burnt-offering of each [Rosh] Chodesh, at its renewal throughout the months of the year.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bullock, and the third part of a hin for a ram, and a fourth part of a hin for a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And their libations: half a hin for the bullock, a third of a hin for the ram, a fourth of a hin for the lamb, wine. This is the burnt-offering of the month in its month [(If the day passes, the offering is annulled and there is no restitution)], for the months of the year.


###### Numbers 28:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:15)


וּשְׂעִ֨יר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֛ד לְחַטָּ֖את לַיהֹוָ֑ה עַל־עֹלַ֧ת הַתָּמִ֛יד יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
And [You shall also bring] one he-goat for a sin offering to Adonoy, in addition to the constant (daily) burnt-offering it shall be done, and its libation.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And one kid of the goats for a sin offering to the Lord shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And one kid of goats as a sin-offering to the L-rd [i.e., where only the L-rd knows of the sin — this, in atonement for defiling the sanctuary or its objects without awareness of having done so (this offering serving as the prototype for all of the additional goat offerings (mussafim) as effecting such atonement)]; in addition to the continual burnt-offering shall it [the complete offering (not just the kid)] be offered, with its [the offering's (not the kid's)] libation.


###### Numbers 28:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:16)


וּבַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ פֶּ֖סַח לַיהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
In the first month—on the fourteenth day of the month [bring a] *Pesach* [offering] to Adonoy.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And on the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the Lord.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, it is Pesach to the L-rd.


###### Numbers 28:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:17)


וּבַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר י֛וֹם לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֖ה חָ֑ג שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים מַצּ֖וֹת יֵאָכֵֽל׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The fifteenth day of that month is a festival, *matzohs* shall be eaten for seven days.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And on the fifteenth day of this month, it is a festival; for seven days matzoth shall be eaten.


###### Numbers 28:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:18)


בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן מִקְרָא־קֹ֑דֶשׁ כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The first day shall be a sacred holiday, any work of consequence you must not do.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
On the first day shall be a holy gathering; you shall do no manner of servile work on it.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
On the first day it is a calling of holiness; all work of labor you shall not do [(Even essential work, which cannot be made up, which is permitted on Chol Hamoed, is forbidden on Yom Tov)].


###### Numbers 28:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:19)


וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה עֹלָה֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁנַ֖יִם וְאַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד וְשִׁבְעָ֤ה כְבָשִׂים֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה תְּמִימִ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall bring a burnt fire-offering to Adonoy [consisting of] two young bulls, one ram, and seven yearling sheep. They shall [all] be without blemish.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And you shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering to the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be to you without blemish:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall present a fire-offering, a burnt-offering to the L-rd, two young bullocks [(in commemoration of the bullock of Abraham (Genesis 18:7)], one ram [(in commemoration of the ram of Isaac (Ibid. 22:13)], and seven one-year-old lambs [(in commemoration of Jacob (Ibid. 30:40)]; unblemished shall they be to you.


###### Numbers 28:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:20)


וּמִ֨נְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַפָּ֗ר וּשְׁנֵ֧י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֛ים לָאַ֖יִל תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Their meal-offering shall be fine flour mixed with [olive] oil, three tenths [of an *eiphah*] for each bull, two tenths [of an *eiphah*] for the ram,


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and their meal offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth measures shall you offer for a bullock, and two tenth measures for a ram;


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And their meal-offering, flour mixed with oil, three esronim for the bullock and two esronim for the ram shall you offer it.


###### Numbers 28:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:21)


עִשָּׂר֤וֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
and one tenth [of an *eiphah*] for each of the seven sheep.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
a tenth measure shalt thou offer for every lamb, for the seven lambs:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Issaron, issaron shall you offer for the one lamb, for the seven lambs.


###### Numbers 28:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:22)


וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
[You should also bring] one he-goat as a sin-offering, to make atonement for you,


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and one goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And one kid as a sin-offering to atone for you.


###### Numbers 28:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:23)


מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַבֹּ֔קֶר אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְעֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֑יד תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ אֶת־אֵֽלֶּה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
in addition to the morning burnt-offering which is offered as a constant (daily) burnt-offering, you shall make these.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
You shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Aside from the burnt-offering of the morning of the daily burnt-offering shall you offer these.


###### Numbers 28:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:24)


כָּאֵ֜לֶּה תַּעֲשׂ֤וּ לַיּוֹם֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים לֶ֛חֶם אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהֹוָ֑ה עַל־עוֹלַ֧ת הַתָּמִ֛יד יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Like these, you shall make daily for seven days, food as a fire-offering of a pleasing aroma to Adonoy, (it shall be offered) in addition to the constant (daily) burnt-offering and its libation.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
After this manner you shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the provision of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour to the Lord: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
As these shall you offer each day [(They are not to decrease progressively as the bullocks of Succoth)] for seven days, the food of a fire-offering, a sweet savor to the L-rd; in addition to the continual burnt-offering shall it be offered, and its libation.


###### Numbers 28:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:25)


וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִקְרָא־קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃{ס}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The seventh day shall be a sacred holiday to you, when you shall not do any work of consequence.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And on the seventh day you shall have a holy gathering; you shall do no servile work.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And on the seventh day, a calling of holiness shall it be for you; all work of labor you shall not do.


###### Numbers 28:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:26)


וּבְי֣וֹם הַבִּכּוּרִ֗ים בְּהַקְרִ֨יבְכֶ֜ם מִנְחָ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה בְּשָׁבֻעֹ֖תֵיכֶ֑ם מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
On the day of the first fruits when you bring a new meal-offering to Adonoy on your Festival of Weeks, there shall be a sacred holiday to you when you shall not do any work of consequence.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Also on the day of the firstfruits, when you bring a new meal offering to the Lord, in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy gathering; you shall do no servile work.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And on the day of first-fruits [(Shavuoth is designated as the "first" of the wheat harvest (Exodus 34:22) by reason of the two loaves (Leviticus 23:17), the first of the wheaten meal-offerings brought from the new grain)], when you offer a new meal-offering to the L-rd in (the completion of) your weeks (see Leviticus 23:15), a calling of holiness shall it be for you; all work of labor you shall not do.


###### Numbers 28:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:27)


וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עוֹלָ֜ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁנַ֖יִם אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד שִׁבְעָ֥ה כְבָשִׂ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
You shall make a burnt-offering of a pleasing aroma to Adonoy [consisting of] two young bulls, one ram, [and] seven yearling lambs.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And you shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour to the Lord; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall present a burnt-offering, as a sweet savor to the L-rd, two young bullocks, one ram, and seven one-year-old lambs.


###### Numbers 28:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:28)


וּמִ֨נְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֣ר הָֽאֶחָ֔ד שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים לָאַ֖יִל הָאֶחָֽד׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Their meal-offering [shall be] fine flour mixed with [olive] oil, three tenths [of an *eiphah*] for each bull, two tenths [of an *eiphah*] for the one ram,


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and their meal offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth measures for one bullock, two tenth measures for one ram,


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And their meal-offering: flour mixed with oil, three esronim for the one bullock, two esronim for the one ram.


###### Numbers 28:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:29)


עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
and one tenth [of an *eiphah*] for each of the seven lambs.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
a tenth measure for one lamb, for the seven lambs;

Issaron, issaron for the one lamb, for the seven lambs.


###### Numbers 28:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:30)


שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים אֶחָ֑ד לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
[You should also bring] one he-goat to make atonement for you,


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and one kid of the goats, to make atonement for you.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
One kid of goats to atone for you.


###### Numbers 28:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/28:31)


מִלְּבַ֞ד עֹלַ֧ת הַתָּמִ֛יד וּמִנְחָת֖וֹ תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיוּ־לָכֶ֖ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
in addition to bringing the constant (daily) burnt-offering and its meal- offering. [The sacrifices] shall be without blemish—and their libations.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
You shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, (they shall be to you without blemish) and their drink offerings.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Aside from the continual burnt-offering and its meal-offering shall you offer (them). Unblemished shall they be for you, and their libations. [Their libations, too, shall be unblemished — whence it is derived that mouldy wine is invalid.]



## Chapter 29

###### Numbers 29:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/29:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/29:1)


וּבַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ י֥וֹם תְּרוּעָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
The first day of the seventh month shall be a sacred holiday to you when you shall not do any work of consequence. It shall be a day of sounding the ram’s horn.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy gathering; you shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the horn to you.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be unto you a calling of holiness. All work of labor you shall not do; a day of teruah (blowing the shofar) shall it be for you.


###### Numbers 29:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/29:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/29:2)


וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה פַּ֧ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**

**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And their meal-offering and their libations: for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, as prescribed. [The seventy bullocks of the Succoth festival correspond to the seventy nations, their progressive diminution during the festival alluding to the ultimate destruction of the nations. The lambs correspond to Israel, which is called "a scattered lamb" (Jeremiah 50:17). Their number is fixed, and their total (ninety-eight) alludes to their serving to avert the ninety-eight curses of the book of Deuteronomy. The three variant letters (mem in veniskeihem (19), yod in unesachehah (31), and mem in kemishpatam (33), spell out "mayim" (water), an allusion to the water libation on Succoth.)]

## Chapter 30

###### Numbers 30:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/30:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/30:1)


וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃{פ}


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Moshe spoke to Bnei Yisroel all that Adonoy had commanded him.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Moshe told the children of Yisra᾽el according to all that the Lord commanded Moshe.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Moses related (it) to the children of Israel, as all that the L-rd had commanded Moses, [viz. 28:2 (This is stated here to obviate the impression that Moses did not tell it to them but proceeded directly to the section that follows.)]


###### Numbers 30:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/30:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/30:2)


וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־רָאשֵׁ֣י הַמַּטּ֔וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָֽה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Moshe spoke to the tribal leaders of Bnei Yisroel saying: “This is the word that Adonoy has commanded.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Moshe spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Yisra᾽el, saying, This is the thing which the Lord has commanded.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel [(according them honor by instructing them first, and then instructing the children of Israel (this being stated here specifically in respect to vows though it was the mode for all teachings (see Exodus 34:31-32), in order to teach that the annulment of vows is effected by one expert (in vows), or, in his absence, by three non-experts)], saying: This is the thing that the L-rd has commanded.


###### Numbers 30:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/30:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/30:3)


אִישׁ֩ כִּֽי־יִדֹּ֨ר נֶ֜דֶר לַֽיהֹוָ֗ה אֽוֹ־הִשָּׁ֤בַע שְׁבֻעָה֙ לֶאְסֹ֤ר אִסָּר֙ עַל־נַפְשׁ֔וֹ לֹ֥א יַחֵ֖ל דְּבָר֑וֹ כְּכׇל־הַיֹּצֵ֥א מִפִּ֖יו יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
If a man makes a vow to Adonoy or makes an oath; to initiate a prohibition himself; he may not profane his word. He shall do all that he said.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If a man vow a vow to the Lord, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A man, if he vow a vow to the L-rd [(not to eat something or not to do something)], or if he take an oath to bind a bond upon his soul [i.e., to forbid to himself something which is permitted (but not, to permit to himself something which is forbidden)], he shall not profane his word. According to all that issues from his mouth shall he do.


###### Numbers 30:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/30:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/30:4)


וְאִשָּׁ֕ה כִּֽי־תִדֹּ֥ר נֶ֖דֶר לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְאָסְרָ֥ה אִסָּ֛ר בְּבֵ֥ית אָבִ֖יהָ בִּנְעֻרֶֽיהָ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
[But] if a woman makes a vow to Adonoy or obligates herself in her father’s home while still in her youth,


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If a woman also vow a vow to the Lord, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father’s house in her youth;


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And a woman, if she vow a vow to the L-rd and bind a bond (see above) in her father's house [(i.e., when she is under her father's authority)], in her maidenhood, [after twelve years and one day, (and not when she is a minor, in which instance her vow is not a vow, nor when she is a bogereth (after maidenhood), in which instance she is not under her father's authority for him to annul her vow)],


###### Numbers 30:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/30:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/30:5)


וְשָׁמַ֨ע אָבִ֜יהָ אֶת־נִדְרָ֗הּ וֶֽאֱסָרָהּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽסְרָ֣ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֔הּ וְהֶחֱרִ֥ישׁ לָ֖הּ אָבִ֑יהָ וְקָ֙מוּ֙ כׇּל־נְדָרֶ֔יהָ וְכׇל־אִסָּ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָ֥ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֖הּ יָקֽוּם׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
and her father hears her vow or her self-imposed prohibition and remains silent, then all her vows shall stand and the self-imposed prohibition shall stand.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and her father hear her vow, and her bond with which she has bound herself, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she has bound herself shall stand.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And her father hear her vow and her bond wherewith she bound her soul, and her father be silent to her, then all of her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.


###### Numbers 30:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/30:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/30:6)


וְאִם־הֵנִ֨יא אָבִ֣יהָ אֹתָהּ֮ בְּי֣וֹם שׇׁמְעוֹ֒ כׇּל־נְדָרֶ֗יהָ וֶֽאֱסָרֶ֛יהָ אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָ֥ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֖הּ לֹ֣א יָק֑וּם וַֽיהֹוָה֙ יִֽסְלַח־לָ֔הּ כִּי־הֵנִ֥יא אָבִ֖יהָ אֹתָֽהּ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
But if her father restrained her on the day he heard it, then all her vows and self imposed prohibitions shall not stand. Adonoy will forgive her because her father has restrained her.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But if her father disallow her in the day that he hears; not any of her vows, or of her bonds with which she has bound herself, shall stand: and the Lord shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And if her father constrain her [i.e., if he annuls her vow] on the day that he hears, then all her vows and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall not stand, and the L-rd shall forgive her, for her father has constrained her. [(Scripture speaks of a woman whose husband, unknown to her, had annulled a vow of Naziritism that he had heard her make, and who had violated her vow by drinking wine or by becoming unclean to the dead. Though the vow is annulled, she requires forgiveness. (How much more so, one whose vow was not annulled!)]

## Chapter 31

###### Numbers 31:1

Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the Lord spoke to Moshe saying,


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the L-rd spoke to Moses, saying:


###### Numbers 31:2

נְקֹ֗ם נִקְמַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאֵ֖ת הַמִּדְיָנִ֑ים אַחַ֖ר תֵּאָסֵ֥ף אֶל־עַמֶּֽיךָ׃

“Take revenge for Bnei Yisroel against the Midianites, afterward, you shall be gathered to your people (die).”


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Execute the vengeance of the children of Yisra᾽el on the Midyanim: afterwards thou shalt be gathered to thy people.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Take the revenge of the children of Israel from the Midianites [(but not from the Moavites, the latter having been motivated by fear of Israel's plundering them, but the former having entered into a quarrel which was not theirs)]; afterwards you will be gathered unto your people.


###### Numbers 31:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/31:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/31:3)


וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־הָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר הֵחָלְצ֧וּ מֵאִתְּכֶ֛ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לַצָּבָ֑א וְיִהְיוּ֙ עַל־מִדְיָ֔ן לָתֵ֥ת נִקְמַת־יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּמִדְיָֽן׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Moshe spoke to the people, saying: “Arm men from among yourselves for the army and they will be against Midian, to bring revenge of Adonoy against Midian.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Moshe spoke to the people, saying, Arm from yourselves men for the army, and let them go against Midyan and avenge the Lord on Midyan.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Moses spoke to the people [(with joy, though his death was attendant upon the defeat of Midian)], saying: Arm from yourselves men [tzaddikim] for the host, and let them be against Midian to execute the vengeance of the L-rd against Midian [(opposing Israel being tantamount to opposing the L-rd)].


###### Numbers 31:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/31:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/31:4)


אֶ֚לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֶ֖לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֑ה לְכֹל֙ מַטּ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תִּשְׁלְח֖וּ לַצָּבָֽא׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
One thousand from each tribe, one thousand from each tribe, for all of the tribes of Yisroel, you shall send into the army.”


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Yisra᾽el, shall you send to the war.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A thousand to a tribe, a thousand to a tribe, of all the tribes of Israel [including the tribe of Levi] shall you send to the host.


###### Numbers 31:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/31:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/31:5)


וַיִּמָּֽסְרוּ֙ מֵאַלְפֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶ֖לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֑ה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא׃

They were handed over from among the thousands of Yisroel, one thousand from each tribe, twelve thousand armed men for the army.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
So there were delivered out of the thousands of Yisra᾽el, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And there were handed over [(perforce)] of the thousands of Israel, [(the men, knowing that Moses' death was attendant upon the defeat of Midian, refusing to come forward on their own)], a thousand to a tribe, twelve thousand men armed for the host.


###### Numbers 31:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/31:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/31:6)


וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח אֹתָ֥ם מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶ֥לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֖ה לַצָּבָ֑א אֹ֠תָ֠ם וְאֶת־פִּ֨ינְחָ֜ס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ לַצָּבָ֔א וּכְלֵ֥י הַקֹּ֛דֶשׁ וַחֲצֹצְר֥וֹת הַתְּרוּעָ֖ה בְּיָדֽוֹ׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
Moshe sent, one thousand from each tribe to the army, them, and Pinchas, son of Elozor the *kohein* to the army, with the sacred vessels and the trumpets in his hand.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Moshe sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Pineĥas the son of El῾azar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Moses sent them, a thousand to a tribe, to the host, them and Pinchas the son of Elazar the Cohein to the host, [Pinchas being "equivalent" to all of them, (and Pinchas going rather than Elazar in that he began the mitzvah (of executing vengeance against Midian) by having slain Kazbi, the daughter of Tzur)], and the holy articles [the ark and the tzitz] and the trumpets of teruah in his hand [i.e., with him].


###### Numbers 31:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/31:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/31:7)

**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
They mounted a campaign against Midian, as Adonoy had commanded Moshe, and they killed every male.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they warred against Midyan, as the Lord commanded Moshe, and they slew all the males.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they warred against Midian as the L-rd had commanded Moses, and they killed every male.


###### Numbers 31:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/31:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/31:8)


וְאֶת־מַלְכֵ֨י מִדְיָ֜ן הָרְג֣וּ עַל־חַלְלֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת־אֱוִ֤י וְאֶת־רֶ֙קֶם֙ וְאֶת־צ֤וּר וְאֶת־חוּר֙ וְאֶת־רֶ֔בַע חֲמֵ֖שֶׁת מַלְכֵ֣י מִדְיָ֑ן וְאֵת֙ בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן־בְּע֔וֹר הָרְג֖וּ בֶּחָֽרֶב׃


**Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009:**
They killed the Midianite kings upon those they had slain: Evi, Rekem, Tzur, Chur and Reva—[the] five kings of Midian. And Bil’am son of Beor they killed with the sword.


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they slew the kings of Midyan, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Reqem, and Żur, and Ḥur, and Reva, five kings of Midyan: Bil῾am also the son of Be῾or they slew with the sword.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the kings of Midian they killed, [causing them to fall] upon their slain: Evi and Rekem, and Tzur, and Chur, and Reva, the five kings of Midian ["of one counsel (against Israel) and of one death"]; and Bilam the son of Beor they slew by the sword [("He exchanged his trade for theirs (desiring to destroy Israel by speech), and they exchanged their trade for his" (killing him by the sword)].

You must not defile the land in which you live, wherein I reside, for, I, Adonoy, dwell among Bnei Yisroel.’”

And thou shalt not defile the land which you shall inhabit, in which I dwell: for I the Lord dwell among the children of Yisra᾽el.


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you shall not defile the land which you inhabit, in which I dwell [(so that you not cause Me to dwell in its uncleanliness)], for I, the L-rd, dwell in the midst of the children of Israel [even when they are unclean].



## Chapter 36

###### Numbers 36:1

וַֽיִּקְרְב֞וּ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֗וֹת לְמִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בְּנֵֽי־גִלְעָד֙ בֶּן־מָכִ֣יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה מִֽמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֑ף וַֽיְדַבְּר֞וּ לִפְנֵ֤י מֹשֶׁה֙ וְלִפְנֵ֣י הַנְּשִׂאִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the chief fathers of the family of the children of Gil῾ad, the son of Makhir, the son of Menashshe, of the families of the sons of Yosef, came near, and spoke before Moshe, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Yisra᾽el:


**The Rashi chumash by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

and they said, The Lord commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Yisra᾽el: and my lord was commanded by the Lord to give the inheritance of Żelofĥad our brother to his daughters.

###### Numbers 36:3

וְ֠הָי֠וּ לְאֶחָ֞ד מִבְּנֵ֨י שִׁבְטֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לְנָשִׁים֒ וְנִגְרְעָ֤ה נַחֲלָתָן֙ מִנַּחֲלַ֣ת אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְנוֹסַ֕ף עַ֚ל נַחֲלַ֣ת הַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖ינָה לָהֶ֑ם וּמִגֹּרַ֥ל נַחֲלָתֵ֖נוּ יִגָּרֵֽעַ׃

And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Yisra᾽el, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they are joined: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

###### Numbers 36:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/36:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Numbers/r/36:4)


וְאִם־יִהְיֶ֣ה הַיֹּבֵל֮ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְנֽוֹסְפָה֙ נַחֲלָתָ֔ן עַ֚ל נַחֲלַ֣ת הַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖ינָה לָהֶ֑ם וּמִֽנַּחֲלַת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ יִגָּרַ֖ע נַחֲלָתָֽן׃
